newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta government has new faces in finance,energy.
newsitem.headline: Alberta government has new faces in finance,energy.

text.p: Alberta Premier Ralph Klein named his new cabinet on Wednesday, with notable changes in the finance and energy ministries.
Klein, whose Conservative government was re-elected in a landslide victory two weeks ago, said Stockwell Day became provincial treasurer.

Day, family and social services minister in Klein's previous term, replaced Jim Dinning, who retired from politics after being hailed as a major force behind the wealthy province's recent economic resurgence.
Klein said Steve West, former minister of economic development and tourism, and known as a staunch fiscal conservative, assumed the energy portfolio in the oil and gas-rich province.
West replaced Pat Black, who was lauded by energy executives for her policies favoring market forces as opposed to government intervention.
Black was appointed minister of economic development and tourism, West's old post.
